+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import textwrap
+
+from .formatting import wrap_text
+
+_INDENT = "  "
+
+
+# groundwork: allow-duplicate public panel API that delegates to wrap_text
+def notice_panel(text: str, width: int = 78) -> str:
+    """Format ``text`` as a notice panel: wrapped paragraphs where every
+    line is indented by two spaces.
+
+    Paragraphs are separated by blank lines, which are kept. The
+    indentation of each paragraph relative to the others is preserved.
+    A paragraph whose first line is only the ``\\b`` character
+    (``\\x08``) is preformatted and is indented but not rewrapped, as in
+    help text.
+
+    :param text: the text to format.
+    :param width: the maximum line width, including the indent, for
+        wrapped paragraphs. Must be at least 4.
+    :raises ValueError: if ``width`` is less than 4.
+    """
+    if width < 4:
+        raise ValueError(f"width must be at least 4, got {width}.")
+
+    if not text:
+        return ""
+
+    rv = wrap_text(
+        textwrap.dedent(text.expandtabs()),
+        width,
+        initial_indent=_INDENT,
+        subsequent_indent=_INDENT,
+        preserve_paragraphs=True,
+    )
+    return "\n".join(line or _INDENT for line in rv.splitlines())

+import pytest
+
+from click.notice_panel import notice_panel
+
+
+def test_empty():
+    assert notice_panel("") == ""
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [3, 0, -1])
+def test_width_too_small(width):
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        notice_panel("text", width=width)
+
+
+def test_minimum_width():
+    assert notice_panel("ab cd", width=4) == "  ab\n  cd"
+
+
+def test_wraps_and_indents():
+    text = "word " * 40
+    out = notice_panel(text, width=30)
+    lines = out.splitlines()
+    assert len(lines) > 1
+    assert all(line.startswith("  ") for line in lines)
+    assert all(len(line) <= 30 for line in lines)
+    assert " ".join(out.split()) == text.strip()
+
+
+def test_paragraphs_and_indentation():
+    text = (
+        "First paragraph is here.\n"
+        "\n"
+        "    Indented paragraph that is long enough to wrap.\n"
+        "\n"
+        "Last."
+    )
+    assert notice_panel(text, width=30).splitlines() == [
+        "  First paragraph is here.",
+        "  ",
+        "      Indented paragraph that",
+        "      is long enough to wrap.",
+        "  ",
+        "  Last.",
+    ]
+
+
+def test_common_indentation_removed():
+    text = """
+        Docstring style.
+
+          Nested.
+    """
+    assert notice_panel(text) == "  Docstring style.\n  \n    Nested."
+
+
+def test_preformatted_paragraph():
+    text = (
+        "Intro text.\n"
+        "\n"
+        "\b\n"
+        "a  b   c\n"
+        " indented line that is much longer than the requested width\n"
+        "\n"
+        "Outro."
+    )
+    assert notice_panel(text, width=20).splitlines() == [
+        "  Intro text.",
+        "  ",
+        "  a  b   c",
+        "   indented line that is much longer than the requested width",
+        "  ",
+        "  Outro.",
+    ]
